page.title: Qualifications & training
page.description: Who holds which authorisation and skill, what runs out, what jobs require, training sessions.

gap.expires_before_work: {{qualification}} expires on {{expiresAt}}, before the planned work.
gap.pending_verification: {{qualification}} is recorded but not verified yet.
gap.unvalidated: {{qualification}} is not validated by a manager.
gap.unverifiable: {{qualification}} cannot be checked: the account has no personnel record.

coverage.eachLong: Every person assigned must hold it
coverage.anyLong: At least one person of the crew must hold it

matrix.problemsOnly: Only people with something to do
matrix.caption: Qualification matrix: people in rows, certifications and skills in columns
matrix.emptyHint: Add people in Personnel, then record their certifications and skills here.
matrix.noMatch: No person or qualification matches these filters

sheet.description: Certifications, authorisations and skills of this person.
sheet.expiryHint: Filled from the issue date and the certification's validity; leave empty if it never expires.
sheet.expiryBeforeIssue: The expiry date is before the issue date.
sheet.validateNow: I have checked this skill (validate it now)
sheet.removeSkillConfirm: Remove {{skill}} from this person's skills? Jobs requiring it will no longer count on them.

check.qualified: {{person}} holds every qualification this job requires.
check.overridden: {{person}} may work on this job under a supervisor override.
check.blocked: {{person}} cannot be assigned to this job.
check.expiresSoon: {{qualification}} runs out on {{expiresAt}}: plan the renewal.
check.howToProceed: Record the missing qualifications, choose someone else, or ask an authorised supervisor for an override.
check.howToProceedSupervisor: Record the missing qualifications, choose someone else, or record an override with its reason (it is kept in the audit log).
check.overrideTitle: Let {{person}} work without the missing qualifications
check.overrideDescription: Only for a justified case (supervision on site, renewal in progress…). The override, its reason and your name are recorded and audited. Your identity is checked again.

catalog.intro: Certifications and authorisations the plant tracks, how long they are valid and how early renewal is flagged.
catalog.formDescription: People's certificates of this type expire after the validity; renewal is flagged during the notice period.
catalog.positiveNumber: Enter a whole number above zero.

requirements.intro: Assigning someone who lacks a requirement marked "every person" is refused with the reason; an authorised supervisor can override it, and the override is audited.
requirements.formDescription: What the people doing this kind of job must hold.
requirements.whatSkill: A skill at a minimum level
requirements.retireConfirm: Withdraw this requirement for {{target}}? Assignments will no longer check it.
requirements.emptyHint: Example: electrical work orders require the B1V habilitation; applying a lockout requires the LOTO authorisation.

expiry.intro: Expired, running out or not yet verified, grouped by certification.
expiry.emptyHint: No certification expires within {{count}} days and none waits for verification.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.formDescription: When a session leads to a certification, each person who passes receives it automatically, valid for the certification's period.
sessions.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
sessions.selectHint: Select a session to register people and record results.
sessions.emptyHint: Plan sessions here or from the renewal list.

overrides.intro: Each time an authorised supervisor let someone work without a required qualification.

mine.emptyHint: Your account must be linked to your personnel record to see your certifications here.
